html:
#1.8.0 Update Details
 
It’s time to check out the details of the 1.8.0 update



▣ 3 New Heroes
 
 Spider-Man (Miles Morales), Spider-Gwen, and Silk join the fight for the future!
 

 
The new heroes also bring with them new team bonuses and trophies! Make sure to check them out once the patch launches!
 
▣ 7 New Uniforms
 
 7 New Uniforms have been added for Captain America, Spider-Man, Gamora, Captain Marvel, War Machine, Black Bolt and Sister Grimm.

 
 
 * New Uniforms are available for a discounted price during a certain period.
 

 
▣ 4 New 6★ Skills
 
 Rocket Raccoon, Groot, Gamora, and Ant-Man have received their 6★ Skills!
 ø Unfortunately we found a critical error with Captain Marvel’s 6★ Skill, which has delayed the release of her 6 ★ skill.

 
 
 1. Rocket Raccoon: I've got a Plan
 2. Groot: We Are Groot!
 3. Gamora: Slide and Slice
 4. Ant-Man: Pym Discs
 
▣ Character Rebalancing
 
 Every hero's normal attack damage has improved. Below is a list of other skills and attack ranges that we have improved also.
 
 1. All Character's normal attack has been improved
 

 
 2. Lash (including Uniform)
  - Undeserving: Pulls enemies closer together.
 
 3. Elsa Bloodstone
  - All skills have been improved to hit enemies more effectively.
 
 4. Ant-Man (including Uniform)
  - Flying Rush: Skill has been improved to hit enemies more effectively.
 
 5. Gamora (including Uniform)
- Normal Attack Damage increased.
- Death Dealer: Skill improved to hit enemies more effectively.
- Spinning Slash: Damage increased.
 
 6. Jessica Jones
- Powerhouse: Skill improved to hit enemies more effectively.
- Powerhouse: Earth Quake Effect remains on the ground.
  - Collateral Damage: Dust Effect remains on the ground.
  - Bum-rush: Last hit of the attack hits enemies more effectively.
  - All skill animations can be canceled once the hits have finished.
 
 7. Iron Fist (including Uniform)
  - Pressure Point Jab: Inflicts additional damage based on the received damage taken while casting.
  - Pressure Point Jab: Skill now has tracking.
  - The Iron Fist: Dragon can hit up to 3 times during casting if an enemy is close.
  - The Iron Fist: Skill now has tracking.
 
 8. Rocket Raccoon
- Trip Mine: Mines remain on the field longer.
- Trip Mine: Cooldown Time decreased.
- Trip Mine: If an enemy triggers a mine, it explodes and also reduces enemy defense.
- Ion Cannon: Damage increased.
- Cunning Tactician: Activates more frequently.
 
 9. Hulk (including Uniform)
  - Normal Attack are faster.
  - Thunder Clap: Attack range width increased.
  - Hulk Smash: Attack range width slightly improved.
  - Hulk Stomp: Skill damage and casting time decreased.
- Hulk Stomp: Max number of hits increased.
- Hulk Stomp: Cooldown Time decreased.
 
10. Captain Marvel (including Uniforms)
- Photon Blast: Cooldown Time decreased.
- Photon Blast: Damage increased.
- Binary Explosion: Damage increased.
- Absorb Energy: Skill mechanics changed (Energy Attack Reflection ▶ Attack Stat increased based on damage she takes from enemies)
 
11. Groot (including Uniform)
- Spore: Cooldown Time changes based on Skill Level and its defense stat buff has been removed.
 
12. Star-Lord
- Normal Attack damage increased.
- Hadron Enforcer: Damage increased.
- I have a Plan: Damage increased.
- Power of Orb: Damage increased.
- Power of Orb: Cooldown Time decreased.
- Link with the Milano: Percentage of Dodge Ignore increased.
 
13. Ultron (including Uniforms)
- No Strings: His minions now have more HP.
 
14. Other Passive and Leader Skill Modification
- Captain America (including Uniforms) – Ready for Battle: Fixed stat boost changed to a percentage based boost.
- Blade (including Uniform) – Catching weak point: Fixed stat boost changed to a percentage based boost.
- Black Widow (including Uniforms) - Infiltrator: Fixed stat boost changed to a percentage based boost.
- Black Cat (including Uniform) – Catlike Reflex: Fixed stat boost changed to a percentage based boost.
- Loki – Energy Barrier: Barrier effect and Cooldown times changed based on skill level, and its Attack Speed boost has been removed.
- Red Skull - Strategist: Fixed stat boost changed to a percentage based boost.
- Red Skull – Military Resistance: Activates faster.
- Doctor Octopus – Tentacle Block: Fixed stat boost changed to a percentage based boost
- Drax – Cry for Blood: Fixed stat boost changed to a percentage based boost, and its Cooldown Time changes based on Skill Level
- Mockingbird (including Uniform) - Concentration: Attack/Movement Speed boost changed to All Speed boost.
- Winter Soldier – Sensory Array: Cooldown Time changes based on Skill Level.
- Punisher (Including Uniform) – Killer Instinct: Fixed stat boost changed to a percentage based boost.
- Iron Fist (including Uniform) – K'un-Lun Focus: Fixed stat boost changed to a percentage based boost.
- Bullseye (include Uniform) - Assassination: Fixed stat boost changed to a percentage based boost.
- Wasp - Encouragement: Fixed Stat boost changed to a percentage based boost.
- Ultron (including Uniforms) - Reactivate: Add burning immune.
- Destroyer – Odin's Enchantment: Reflects more damage from energy attacks.
- Red Hulk – Absorb Radiation: Activates faster.
- Black Bolt (including Uniform) – Cosmic Awareness: Activates more frequently while its Cooldown Time decreased.
- Angela – Asgardian Blood: Crowd Control Time decreasing rate increased.
- Singularity – Cosmic Pull: Skill mechanics changed. Now applies to self: Immune to Guard Break, Paralyze Resist and Stun Resist.
- Yellow Jacket – Fear of the Sting: Based on skill level, Paralyzing time and activation rate changed. (Paralyzing remains total of 3 seconds).
- Blade (including Uniform) – Day walker: Activating Time and Cooldown Time decreased.
- Phil Coulson - Director: Activation Rate and Time increased.
- Daredevil (including Uniform) – Concentration of Senses: Activation Rate increased.
- Malekith – Wild Hunt: Activation Rate increased.
- Falcon – Loyal Ally: Skill effect decreased a little, and it has been changed to permanent effect.
- Luke Cage - Heroes for Hire: Cooldown Time and Activation Time changes based on skill level.
 
 
▣ Character Progression Improvement
 
 For your convenience, Maximum Skill level has been decreased and based on heroes' level, their Gears will be automatically upgraded to +5.
 

 1. Skill Level Before and After
- Max level of characters skill level decreased to 6, and Skill levels that were higher than 6 will be automatically adjusted to reflect this


  - Due to skill level simplification, levels of skill effectiveness are changed.

  2. Gear upgrade to +5
- Based on Characters' level, all gears will be upgraded to +5 automatically.

 3. Gear Upgrade using Crystals
  - You may now use your Crystals to upgrade gears without required materials consumed
   * Gear Upgrade using Crystals can be done up to +15.
 
 
▣ Daily & Bonus Mission Improvement
 
 For your convenience, Daily and Bonus Missions have been merged into one.
 

 
 1. Daily and Bonus Missions are merged into One Mission. If you run New Daily Mission 5 times, you will earn Gold, ISO-8 and Norn Stones.
 
- Daily Maximum Entry: 5
- Available Rewards: ISO-8 depends on the day, Norn Stones and Gold
- Require Energy: 6
 
 2. Due to the merging of Daily and Bonus Missions, some Achievements have been changed

 
 ▣ Story Mission Improvement
 
 With this modification, you will be able to finish stages faster.
 
 1. Royal Rumble
- Now you can deal with more enemies at once.
- Certain character skills now provide a new knock-out animation for enemies!
 
 
 2. Stage length simplified and a reduction in total amount of time need to clear the stages
  - Stages have been made shorter (but there is still the same amount of enemies in the stage)
 
▣ Villain Siege Improvement
 
 You may use your characters more strategically to play Villain Siege
 
 1. Once you clear the rounds of Villain Siege, Stages remain unlocked.
   You can now choose which order you want to play the villain siege in!
 

 
  * All stage bosses can be defeated only once a day. Daily entry limit will be reset after server reset
 
  2. If you fail on a Villain Siege, you may choose your characters right away without any loading screens
 

 
▣ Dimension Rift Improvement
 
 If you find any Dimension Rift, you now have a choice to open it whenever you want
 

 
  1. How to Open Dimension Rift whenever you want
    - Tap "Dimension Rift" Button on Right Bottom Corner
    - Press Open Button like the image above and you will see the pop up that confirm your decision.
    - If you don't open the dimension rift, it will disappear when the server hits daily reset.
 
  2. Dimension Rift Additional reward Improvement
   - If your friend clears your dimension rift, bonus rewards are changed depending on each dimension rifts
 
▣ Attendance Reward System Improvement
 
 Better information and Better rewards are available on Daily Attendance!
 

  1. Better Rewards
   - 1 Hero chest each week and total of 400 Crystals! We hope these new rewards help you to save the future!
 
 2. Attendance System Improvement
   - Monthly reset will no longer occur, instead, your attendance sheet will reset after you claim 28th attendance reward which is a 3~6★ Hero Chest.
 
▣ Inventory Improvement
 
 For your convenience, new functions have been added such as Sell Selected in every tabs and, sort by item rank.
 
 
  1. Cover Tab Added: You can check the cover pieces in inventory with this tab.
  2. Rank: You can sort items by their rank.
  3. Sell Selected: You can sell many items at once with this new button!
 
▣ Alliance Max Level Increase and Improvement
 
 Alliance gets its maximum level increased and Contribution Rewards have been added.
 
 1. Increase Alliance Max Level
  - Alliance Max level increased from 20 to 30.
  - Based on the Alliance Level, maximum number of alliance members has increased.



  2. Contribution Point Improvement
  - Weekly Contribution Points changed to Daily.
  - Your alliance can gain contribution points by members even though the alliance level is maxed.
    * Actual Alliance EXP will not accumulate.
 
 3. Accumulated Contribution
  - Reward based on Daily and Total Contribution Point will be sent to your mail.
    * If you reach certain points, your reward will be automatically sent to your mail.
    * Reward will be reset at every server reset.
 
 4. If you move out from an alliance and if it's your first time, there will be no penalty to rejoin another alliance.
 
▣ Chatting Improvement
 
 You may now have real conversations with other agents!

 
 1. Chatting during Missions is available
 2. Your Main Character (Character in the Middle of team#1) will be shown on chatting screen.
 3. You may type maximum of 60 letters at once, and the chat room saves a total of 100 messages.
 4. System messages like New Hero, Rank Up, and Mastery will only noticed when a character reaches 6★.
 5. Now you can share your Hero gain, Rank up, Master to your Alliance Chat.
 6. Join, Leave, Kickout, Class change messages will remain on Alliance Chatting and you may able to check history.
 7. Each Message shows what time the message was sent.
 8. You can join different language chatting channel. If it's your first time using new chatting system, it will automatically set your specific language channel depends on what language you set to play game.
 9. Member Login/Logout messages will no longer posted.
 
▣ Other Improvements
 
 1. For your convenience, VIP Features have been improved.
 2. You will see character's information when you open a hero chest.
 3. All purchasable boosters upgraded from 30% to 100%.
 4. Tutorial has been modified more simply so that does not disturb during the missions.
 5. The following missions will not have enemy shifters: Story Mission 2-8, 4-9, 5-8, 6-6, and 8-7.
 6. Component Packs removed, Gear Up Materials added to chapters 9 and 10 in Story Mode.
 7. Fixed an issue with Timeline Battle that your team changed with unexpected characters.
 8. Fixed an issue with Elsa Bloodstone that her skill can knock enemies out of the arena.
 9. Fixed an issue with Dare Devil Uniform effect applied to opponent as well.
 10. Fixed an issue with She-Hulk's Leadership Skill applying to opponent as well.
 11. Fixed an issue with Warwolf 6★ that does not strengthen some skills.
 12. Fixed an issue with Enemy Shifter Doctor Octopus not using any normal attacks in certain occasions.
 13. Fixed an issue with Jessica Jones where she gets stuck in some places.
 14. You may activate unlimited button when you reach 100% during special mission without going back to the special mission menu.


EDIT

1. For suitable in-game balance, we have set the maximum amount of some status.
※ if the status exceed the maximum point, points will not be affected.

- Crowdcontrol time decrease (MAX) 75%
- Skill Cooldown Time decrease (MAX) 50%
- Fire/Cold/Lightning/Poison/Mind Damage Regist (MAX) 75%
- Recovery Rate (MAX) 200%
- Defence Penetration (MAX) 50%
